d: Two identical figures with slender builds and a youthful, adolescent maturity feature long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and small side-tails tied with yellow ribbons. Their wide, expressive eyes are a bright cyan blue. They wear matching short, white sleeveless sailor-style dresses with black underskirts, yellow bows at the chest, and black strappy sandals over white socks. One holds a large, futuristic blue and black mechanical sword, while the other carries a small blue bag.
